junctions.geometryEvidence: app/data/rail-sections.json + rail-history.json: identical existing 5-decimal vertex on both identities; 128.403 m along track to station display point (station segment endpoint plus within-station distance). Identity-agnostic shortest path 森本 → 中津幡 (7967.461 m) passes the vertex with an incoming from-identity edge and outgoing to-identity edge. Geometry details: geometry.json.
junctions.temporalEvidence: validFrom is unbounded: 2015-03-14 is a company-split or ownership date, not when the physical link existed. The physical connection is as old as the rows. Official dated history establishes this connection or an earliest documented existing through service, not necessarily the first physical opening.

lineIDs: jp-IRいしかわ鉄道-IRいしかわ鉄道線
jp-西日本旅客鉄道-北陸線
junctions.geometryEvidence: app/data/rail-sections.json has IRいしかわ鉄道 IRいしかわ鉄道線 (class 12) at [136.63771, 36.56453]. app/data/rail-history.json has 西日本旅客鉄道 北陸線 (class 11) at the same vertex, valid_to 2024-03-16. zeroLength.
junctions.temporalEvidence: validFrom 2015-03-14, when IR took 金沢～直江津 and met JR 北陸線 at this vertex. JR West history (jrwest-history.html, sha256 4edce5f285d59bb6bb9289da84febb18cac38002347b834b4f8ce5ede555e560) and thunderbird-2014.pdf (sha256 ba8f463f70cbddc892b5f1a497b4eaaf031a23abb2a58b149ca66538c5c82f31) date that transfer 平成27年3月14日 / 3月14日. validTo 2024-03-16 matches rail-history valid_to. The history page says 3月16日北陸新幹線金沢～敦賀間が開業 under the 2024年 heading. Same train: thunderbird-2024.pdf (sha256 4f3d5e482baeea74fb47f68427d09276f441bbc33688c8eb383adc67db3a4964) 2024年3月15日 サンダーバード17号 大阪駅（10：42発）⇒和倉温泉駅（14：30着）. 大阪 is the JR 北陸線 side south of 金沢; 和倉温泉 is beyond 金沢 on IR. 2024-03-15 is inside the window. サンダーバード50号 starts at 金沢 and is not both sides. Dating rule (2026-10-04): validFrom is the physical-link date; 2015-03-14 was a document/ownership date and is kept as evidence only.
